messages:
Amy (AE): Quick question for the team — Acme bank wants a POC. They asked for ISO/SOC2 artifacts, a signed pen-test letter, and confirmation that POC data can be EU-only. Also: do we need to run the pen-test against Dedicated or is hosted ok for their compliance team? Can someone pull a minimal evidence bundle and an ETA? cc @Dan

Dan (SE): I can grab the standard bundle. Couple clarifying q's: 1) Are they asking for 'network diagrams & access patterns' or full on infra runbooks? 2) Is KMS separation required for the POC or only for prod?

Amy (AE): They specifically asked for staging creds + pen-test attestation for POC. Data residency: EU only for customer data in the POC. They also asked whether Dedicated (VPC + dedicated GPUs) equals EU residency compliance.

Lisa - Security: Short answer — yes: Dedicated deployed in eu-west1 with a customer-isolated VPC and customer-managed KMS covers EU residency for data at rest & in transit. For the pen-test: we provide a signed pen-test letter that defines allowed scope and testing rules. For external testers we require SOW + insurance. I'll DM the attestation/letter template. :memo:

Sam - Solutions: I can assemble a POC evidence zip in ~2 business days once Security drops the pen-test template + KMS statement. Pricing note: Dedicated POC may require a 1-week reserved minimum depending on GPU type — that could affect the quote. If they want an on-prem appliance, that becomes a separate sales cycle. :moneybag:

Dan (SE): Minimal file layout I usually send them:
```
 evi-dence/
   soc2-summary.pdf
   iso-summary.pdf
   pen-test-letter-request.pdf  # signed by us + attestation template
   network-diagram.pdf
   kms-attestation.txt
   staging-creds-readme.txt
```
Also give them a secure upload link (presigned) — e.g. `https://files.redwood.example/secure-upload/ACME-POC-123` (placeholder).

AuditBot: Please remember: evidence uploads must go through the secure reviewer flow. Upload link: https://console.redwood.ai/evidence-upload. Ensure files are named with the PoC id and that access is limited. Scan scheduled after upload.

Lisa - Security: A few gating items for the pen-test:
- Scope: non-destructive only (no data exfil, no credential stuffing).
- Need tester legal name, company, and IP ranges up front.
- We sign a pen-test attestation / scope letter and they must sign an SOW.
I'll add a sample signed letter and checklist to the DM. :lock:

Amy (AE): Great — I'll ask Acme for tester details and confirm they accept non-destructive scope. I'll also flag the dedicated-week minimum to procurement so pricing is clear. Will update this thread with the upload link and timeline by EOD. :thumbsup:
